Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
Which of your opponents' decks did your fear most during the tournament?

National Coordinator Germany  nc [dot] germany [at] magenta [dot] de

Messages.Author: Thalco
Messages.Body:
Tended to depend on my draw. Overall I was concerned about the Banu Haqim as a prey because it's difficult to grind down a deck that can steal all your blood in a round. Fortunately, I managed to bait them in to combats when I was ready and got the oust on them in the final. There was a lot of blood sorcery in the room (with 3 thaumaturgy decks making the final table). The final table was really rough for me but luckily there were bigger table threats that I was able to use the table dynamics to levy a victory.

. Prince of Liverpool and UK NC
